newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss bond market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Swiss bond market closing report.

text.p: Swiss bonds were firmer at the close of trade, buoyed by the Swiss franc's firmer tone and strength in other major bond markets.
Activity was seen generally thin as investors started to shut their books before year-end.

CS technical analyst Daniel Gerber said in a report that the Confederate bond future had entered a sideways pattern. At the same time, he said medium-term momentum indicators were falling and the short-term cycle might find a top in the next few days. He said the combination could trigger a fall to the 112.30/113.60 area, well below the day's high of 115.29.

Activity in new issues this week for Ford Credit and Sony was slow. Ford set a 150 million Swiss franc bond with a 3-1/2 percent coupon for four years on Monday. It was quoted by lead manager Credit Suisse CSST yielding 3.31 percent. Syndicate sources said the issue was aimed at the retail public.

Sony set a 150 million Swiss franc bond via Merrill Lynch, also on Monday. The offering, also for four years, has a 3-1/8 percent coupon and was quoted by the lead MLDA on Tuesday yielding 3.07 to 3.08 percent. Some syndicate managers said the Sony issue appeared expensive but one said the borrower was rarely in the market, which argued for a premium.
Dec Comi medium-term bond COMIZ6 up 11 at 109.86
Dec Euro Swiss francs FESM6 up eight at 97.82.
